# AGENTS.md — Build, Test, and Validation Commands
# Auto-generated by spec-to-ralphprep | Project: guided-onboarding-installer
# Ralph writes its code into the ap-hub repo root (C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\ap-hub);
# this ralph-guided-installer/ directory holds only ralph's own state/specs, not app code.

## Environment

No new environment variables — this feature reuses the existing ap-hub `.env` (DATABASE_URL,
QBO_ENV=sandbox, session/SSO vars). `export DATABASE_URL=postgres://aphub:aphub@127.0.0.1:5432/aphub`
must be set before running the gate (DB-backed tests require it, even though this feature adds no
schema change).

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Database

```bash
npm run migrate:up    # idempotent; expect "No pending migrations" (this feature adds none)
```

## Development Server

```bash
npm run web:dev       # Next.js App Router UX — visit /onboarding as an owner_controller
```

## Test

```bash
npm test              # unit + DB-backed (src/** + test/**)
```

## Lint / Type Check

```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
```

## Build (production, covers app/)

```bash
npm run web:build
```

## Validation Commands

```bash
npm run migrate:up && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run web:build
```
